astra_source_specification_text:
Keyence

Batch 2; priority 02.01; **high_requiring_validation**; root class A.
- Baseline: sap_successfactors, scope `default`, failed: source unreachable; public count 0, retained 0. public_company_count. Runs 342/343: failed/failed; same_state_and_reason_3_runs.
- Finding/evidence: Current public page independently reproduces production _table_item schema exception from empty trailing hidden-phone layout cell. Offline identity/normalization replay also checks the entire observed first page. The private run-344 exception is unavailable, so matching that exact historical stack is not asserted. Individually replayed public table at https://careers.keyence.com/search/; variant rmk_table; production effective bounds 20 pages/500 jobs before adaptive completion. Full source identity, pagination and hydration not run. SECOND BLOCKER: identity_regex is absent; source_identity_regex is not its loader alias. A reviewed exact marker is required after parser repair. Reference: evidence/run_344_public_extract.json: original log line 1334; evidence/sap_identity_normalization_replays.json and evidence/sap_identity_candidates.json keyed by company; initial and follow-up parser replays.
- Official proof: First-party employer-owned recruiting hostname; current table structure replayed; validate company/subsidiary scope in canary.
- Repair: Support only the reviewed empty trailing table-layout cell; retain one-to-one header attribution for data cells, exact range/total/next-page validation and stable listing IDs. Add individually reviewed identity_regex where absent; no global fallback from legacy marker. RMK table normalization is listing-only (no mandatory detail hydration). Improve diagnostic category separately. Category: Narrow adapter bug fix.
- Files: src/scraper/company_careers/adapters/sap_successfactors.py; src/scraper/company_careers/scanner.py; tests/test_sap_successfactors.py.
- Identity and scope: preserve exact effective row in BASELINE_533.csv; `keyence::default`. Keep provider requisition ID from canonical listing/detail, exact employer host and scope; prove listing/detail ID agreement, never title hashes.
- Pagination/terminal: rmk_table: result start/end/total + attributed row count + exact next offset and final unique inventory. rmk_tile and rmk_columnized are separate contracts; one restart, no union of changing snapshots.
- Failure/partial behavior: Useful returned positives may be retained; stable unreadable inventory IDs protect existing jobs; rejected/unidentified gaps prevent absence. Failed diagnostic counts are not retained output. Timeouts, malformed response, loops, denied access and second mutation remain incomplete/failed. At most one bounded clean restart; never combine snapshots.
- Deterministic tests: tests/test_sap_successfactors.py; tests/test_inventory_hydration.py; tests/test_source_integrity.py. Cases: Empty trailing reviewed layout td accepted; nonempty/unknown/duplicate-attribution cells rejected; total mismatch, repeated page, hostile next URL, page-size change, unreadable detail with stable listed ID, rejected unidentifiable row, mutation twice, cap and explicit zero.
- Canary: No live call authorized. Plan exact per-source request cap including redirects/retries/hydration; one source at a time, no persistence, stop on block/429, no bypass. First-batch exact plans: batch_01_canary_plan.json; others require source-specific count/detail budget approval as described in IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF.md.
- Activation: Fresh exact-config PASS_COMPLETE; identity+scope+terminal+inventory accounting+mutation checks; no discovery-only/cap/rejection; exact rollback and central finalization; explicit activation authorization.
- Rollback: evidence/prior_registry_rows.json#Keyence ; evidence/prior_overlay_rows.json#Keyence. For migrations, preserve both source ownership records; do not retire or reset absence counters.
- Dependencies/effort: SAP-TABLE-01 parser repair, adversarial fixtures; adequate bounded full-inventory budget; 2-4 engineer-days shared parser/test repair + 0.25-0.5 day/source validation.
- Unresolved: Bounded full-inventory canary not authorized/run; new configuration/parser behavior and full inventory still unvalidated.
